description: On a dynaset over B with CacheSize 5 and one with the default, and for each FillCache argument list [(no argument) ;; Long 5 ;; Long 0 ;; Long -1 ;; Long 21 ;; Long 1000 ;; Long 5, bookmark (0,2,0,0) ;; Missing, bookmark (2,2,0,0) ;; "a" ;; Null ;; Long 5, empty bytes ;; Long 5, "" ;; Long 5, Null]: call FillCache, read CacheStart, EOF, ID and RecordCount. Then assign CacheStart in turn the bookmark-shaped constants empty bytes, four zero bytes, (2,2,0,0), empty string, Long 1, Null and Empty, reading CacheStart and ID after each. Then FillCache() on a snapshot, a table-type and a forward-only recordset, reading CacheStart and ID. Asks the accepted FillCache and CacheStart arguments and whether the call moves the cursor or reports through RecordCount, on a recordset the engine does not cache by default. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
retentionNote: Designed r-cursor-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
